description: The file defines the ThemeModel class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the CorporateBranding API module. It models a theme object for the corporate branding feature, including serialization, data normalization, and conversion to array. The class implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits for serialization. It includes properties for theme attributes like colors, logos, and banners, and handles transformation from a PartialTheme DTO.

classes.name: ThemeModel
classes.description: A model class representing a theme for the OrangeHRM corporate branding API, responsible for serialization and normalization of theme data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ThemeModel with a PartialTheme entity and sets serialization filters and attribute names.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the ThemeModel instance to an array, including logic to add client logo, banner, and login banner filename info if present.
